modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: PAL Airlines allows each passenger one piece of carry-on luggage plus a small personal bag.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 carry-on per passenger, maximum 21” x 9” x 15”.

personal_item.value: A small purse, personal bag or diaper bag, maximum 16” x 6” x 13”, in addition to the carry-on.

air_borealis.value: Connecting Air Borealis Twin Otter flights do not allow carry-on baggage; one (1) free personal item (such as a purse up to 16” x 6” x 13”) is permitted.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Your checked allowance depends on your booked fare class; fees are in Canadian dollars.

checked_bag_fees.value: 1st bag: Basic $40 – $46, Standard $20 – $23, Flexible and Freedom $0. 2nd bag: Basic $80- $92, Standard and Flexible $40 – $46, Freedom $0. 3rd bag: $100 – $115 on every fare. CDN dollars.

size_weight.value: Checked bags must not exceed 50 pounds and 62 linear inches. Bags between 50 lbs and 70 lbs are charged $100.00 – $115.00 as excess; anything over 70 lbs must go by PAL Airlines Cargo.
